fresh.world_prefix: The indicator readings in the present situation are {world}.
fresh.question: Applying my stated rule to these readings, which listed option should I {operation}?

operations.notes: adopt for my written account of the meeting
operations.temperature: use to express an outdoor thermometer reading
operations.length: write for the measurement of a small object
operations.clock: use to show the time of an appointment
operations.mail: adopt for filing the saved correspondence
operations.music: put on when selecting a musical recording

if_else.prefix: My current conditional policy is as follows.
if_else.source_true: If {first} and {second} are both on, I choose {selected}.
if_else.source_false: If at least one of {first} and {second} is off, I choose {other}.
if_else.cases_prefix: The cases are mutually exclusive and exhaustive.
if_else.rule: I choose {selected} if and only if {first} and {second} are both on. Otherwise, I choose {other}.

condition_test.prefix: This is the conditional rule I currently follow.
condition_test.source_true: With both {first} and {second} on, my choice is {selected}.
condition_test.source_false: With either {first} or {second} off, my choice is {other}.
condition_test.cases_prefix: The complete table has these four entries.
condition_test.rule: Both {first} and {second} being on is exactly the condition for my choosing {selected}. In all remaining situations I choose {other}.

trigger_rule.prefix: The following statement specifies my present policy.
trigger_rule.source_true: The joint presence of an on value for {first} and an on value for {second} makes me select {selected}.
trigger_rule.source_false: An off value for {first}, {second}, or both makes me select {other}.
trigger_rule.cases_prefix: Exhaustively, my decisions for the possible observations are these.
trigger_rule.rule: My selection is {selected} precisely in the situation where both {first} and {second} are on, and is {other} in every other situation.

joint_switch.prefix: My decisions follow this two-indicator policy.
joint_switch.source_true: I select {selected} when the two indicators {first} and {second} each show on.
joint_switch.source_false: I select {other} when one or both of the indicators {first} and {second} show off.
joint_switch.cases_prefix: Listing every possible reading gives this complete decision table.
joint_switch.case: For the observation {world}, my selected alternative is {action}.
joint_switch.rule: The alternative I select is governed by a joint test of {first} and {second}. A joint on reading leads me to select {selected}. Any off reading leads me to select {other}.

operations.archive: put at the front when arranging the reports
operations.route: follow when going for a walk
operations.length: use to state the length of a small object
operations.clock: use when writing an appointment time
operations.music: play when picking a recording to hear
